reasons.action: The brief asks for the supplied voice to be reused for the man at the counter, which is an explicit vocal performance/speaking action for that figure; the request therefore governs what the figure is asked to do.
reasons.medium: The only supplied reference is an audio voice-timbre sample, which carries no authority over visual rendering medium, and the medium decision records no reference disposition; the rendering medium is thus settled by the request alone.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference exists to observe clothing on, so there is no competing wardrobe evidence; the request governs wardrobe.
reasons.lighting: The audio reference contains no lighting information and no visual reference was supplied, so nothing observed can outrank or fill the lighting; the request governs lighting.
reasons.framing: There is no visual reference to supply an observed shot scale, viewpoint or composition, and the 16:9 canvas ratio plus the 8-second duration are not framing instructions; framing is left to the request.
reasons.palette: No visual reference supplies color or tonal grading, and the caller's voice description does not describe scene color; palette is therefore request-governed.
